stock.description: Coolpad Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, providing wireless solutions and equipment to markets both within Mainland China and internationally. Its operations are structured into two main divisions: Mobile Phone and Property Investment. The Mobile Phone segment focuses on the entire process of mobile device creation, encompassing the research, development, production, and sale of handsets and their related accessories, as well as delivering wireless application services. The Property Investment segment, on the other hand, is dedicated to real estate investments. Furthermore, the company extends its services to include product design and software development for mobile devices, along with mobile phone repair and property management. Established in 1993 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, the company was formerly named China Wireless Technologies Limited before rebranding to Coolpad Group Limited in January 2014.
